newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - S.Korea - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
SOUTH KOREA, July 15 - Busan - 69 Vessels berthed, 98 at anchorage. Usually two to three days delay due to berth congestion.
Ulsan - 45 Vessels berthed, 17 at anchorage. No delay.
Pohang - 35 Vessels berthed, 12 at anchorage. No delay.
Inchon - 60 Vessels berthed, 34 at anchorage. Usually one or two days delay, due to berth congestion.
